title: Human MAO-B in complex with safinamide
missing_residues_near_active_site: None near active site; N/C-termini only (res 1-2, 502-520 disordered)
notes: CORRECTION to project brief: brief specified 2V60 as the MAO-B+safinamide+FAD structure, but 2V60 actually contains FAD plus a DIFFERENT ligand (7-(3-chlorobenzyloxy)-4-carboxaldehyde-coumarin, from the same Binda et al. 2007 J Med Chem paper). The genuine safinamide-bound MAO-B structure is 2V5Z (also higher resolution: 1.60 A vs 2.00 A). Both retrieved and saved; recommend using 2V5Z for the safinamide reference pose and redocking validation.

title: Human tau-tubulin kinase 1 (TTBK1), apo kinase domain
co_crystal_ligands_het: None (only GOL = glycerol cryoprotectant; NO genuine inhibitor bound)
missing_residues_near_active_site: Disordered residues 12-21 (N-term, before kinase domain start) and 315-343 (C-terminal tail beyond kinase domain); catalytic Lys38 (VAIK motif) and DFG176-178 motif are BOTH fully resolved
active_site_residues_4.5A: No bound ligand to reference; ATP-pocket residues identified by proximity to Lys38/Asp176: Ile48,Gly41,Tyr49,Ile40,Ala61,Lys63,Leu62,Glu47,Glu50,Lys39,Gly42 (putative hinge/ATP-pocket)
notes: IMPORTANT for Phase 1: 4NFM has NO co-crystallized ligand, so it cannot support native-ligand redocking validation directly. Recommend (a) defining the grid box centered on the ATP pocket using the resolved catalytic Lys38/DFG176 motif (both intact), and (b) validating docking protocol via cross-docking of a homologous TTBK2 inhibitor structure (6U0K or 7Q8Y, below) with high sequence/structure identity to TTBK1's kinase domain, then transferring the validated protocol to 4NFM.

title: Human MAO-A in complex with harmine
organism: Homo sapiens (confirmed via UniProt P21397, gene MAOA)
co_crystal_ligands_het: HRM (harmine, a beta-carboline reversible MAO-A inhibitor); also GOL, DCX (detergent) present
missing_residues_near_active_site: No REMARK 465 missing residues recorded (fully modeled)
notes: Confirmed human MAO-A as specified in brief; good resolution and R-free, fully ordered active site — suitable anti-target reference for the selectivity counter-screen.

title: Human TTBK2 kinase domain in complex with Compound 1 (DTQ)
missing_residues_near_active_site: Minor gaps at N-term (res 0-2, 7) and one C-term residue (299); active site (res 27-164 pocket) fully resolved
notes: CORRECTION to project brief: an experimental human TTBK2 kinase-domain structure DOES exist (contrary to the brief's assumption that an AlphaFold model would likely be needed). Both 6U0K and 7Q8Y (below) are real inhibitor-bound crystal structures. Recommend 6U0K or 7Q8Y as the TTBK2 anti-target for Phase 5 counter-screening instead of an AlphaFold model.

title: Human TTBK2 kinase domain in complex with VNG2.73 (compound 42)
missing_residues_near_active_site: Minor N-term gaps (res 0-6); active site fully resolved
notes: Higher resolution and lower R-free than 6U0K; RECOMMENDED as the primary TTBK2 anti-target structure for Phase 5 (best data quality of the two).
